Role overview
We're looking for a Staff Network Systems Engineer to help drive the transition of our global network infrastructure from manually managed and inconsistent configurations to a standardised, version-controlled and increasingly automated operating model.
This hands-on staff-level individual contributor will establish Infrastructure as Code practices, reusable automation, automated validation and safe delivery pipelines. The role will reduce configuration drift, make changes repeatable and auditable, and help the wider team adopt modern software-engineering practices.
Working across network engineering, security, architecture and platform teams, you'll help frame and influence technical direction, create practical standards and guardrails, and remain actively involved in enterprise network engineering and operational delivery.

Assess the network estate, toolchain and operational workflows; identify sources of configuration variance, manual effort and change risk; and help define a phased modernisation roadmap.

Build reusable automation using object-oriented or comparable programming languages such as Python and Go (Golang), together with Terraform, Ansible, APIs and configuration-management tooling.
Develop CI/CD pipelines with automated linting, testing, intended-state validation, drift detection, policy checks, approvals, controlled rollout and reliable rollback patterns.

A strong track record of modernising network infrastructure through automation or Infrastructure as Code in a large, complex production environment.
Strong software-engineering skills in object-oriented or comparable programming languages such as Python and Go (Golang), including maintainable code, structured data, API integration, testing, error handling and documentation.
Practical experience with Terraform, Ansible or comparable tooling, including reusable, idempotent automation components and controlled infrastructure delivery.

Staff-level influence and communication skills, including shaping technical direction across teams, building consensus, contributing to governance forums and developing other engineers.

This is a staff-level role combining hands-on engineering with technical leadership across a global network environment. Increased coverage of network infrastructure managed through version-controlled automation.
Reduced configuration drift, manual intervention, operational toil and dependency on individual subject-matter experts.
Shorter and more predictable change lead times, with improved auditability, validation and rollback confidence.
Lower change-failure rates, maintained service reliability and faster recovery from configuration-related incidents.

You love getting into the weeds—you'll happily roll up your sleeves, get to the lowest level of detail, and run the test yourself to find out what works.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
직무 소개
Selection Excellence 조직은 고객에게 정확하고 신뢰할 수 있는 상품 정보를 제공하여 리테일 플랫폼의 건전성과 고객의 쇼핑 경험을 개선하고, 리테일 비즈니스의 주요 프로그램의 운영을 지원하며 리테일 비즈니스 성장에 기여하는 역할을 수행합니다. 우리는 리테일 상품의 카탈로그와 관련된 사유로 고객 이슈가 발생한 상품을 검수하며, 신속하게 해결하고, 근본 원인을 분석하여 재발 방지 체계를 구축합니다. 또한 변화하는 비즈니스 환경과 새로운 리스크에 대응하기 위해 운영 정책 및 프로세스를 수립하고, 다양한 유관 부서와 협업하여 지속 가능한 운영 체계를 만들어갑니다.
업무 내용
Catalog Quality 및 플랫폼 건전성과 관련된 주요 운영 프로그램 및 프로젝트를 리드하고 성과 지표를 관리합니다.
고객 경험에 영향을 미치는 Catalog 관련 이슈를 신속하게 분석하고 해결하며, 근본 원인을 파악하여 재발 방지 방안을 수립합니다.
기존 운영 프로세스의 비효율 요소를 발굴하고 운영 생산성, 품질 및 정확도 향상을 위한 개선 과제를 주도합니다.
SOP(Standard Operating Procedure) 및 SLA(Service Level Agreement)를 정의하고 지속적으로 최적화합니다.
다수의 프로젝트를 동시에 관리하며 우선순위 설정, 리소스 최적화 및 조직 목표 달성을 지원합니다.

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.
We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Senior Director, Policy Communications
Roblox is looking for an experienced communicator to support a wide range of issues, including leading public affairs communications. You will report to the Chief Communications Officer.
As a member of the Global Communications and Corporate Affairs team, you will guide the development and implementation of corporate positioning and crisis management on a global scale. You will devise specific communications materials and campaigns to inform and educate our community, opinion leaders, media about the benefits of Roblox products, our company culture/values and our approach to public policy issues of the day. You will follow the regulatory environment that impacts our industry and, as appropriate, work with the policy team to comment on or respond to legislation. You will participate in face-to-face meetings with commentators and other opinion formers, develop print and web-based material supporting these campaigns, and counter misinformation that might interfere with our business and ability to serve our community.
This role will ideally be based in either our Washington DC or San Mateo, CA offices (hybrid Tues-Thurs).
You will:
Advise and collaborate with multiple teams, including product, public policy, legal, international expansion, and Trust & Safety to help communicate with media and journalists.
Handle high-profile and urgent issues while remaining calm and demonstrating good judgment.
Use your deep understanding of the media landscape and media relationships to build relationships and strategic recommendations that help drive and support our goals.
Develop global positions on key issues and the strategy for reactive and proactive communications plans.
Provide recommendations and propose public messaging to comment on industry regulatory issues and legislation that could affect Roblox.
Develop campaign strategies to educate policy makers and the Roblox community on key issues, in partnership with the policy team.
Successfully create and execute crisis communications and risk mitigation plans
Partner with the Roblox Policy teams to distill complex concepts into coherent and easy to understand communications material, including regular outreach to press around policy updates.
Draft press releases, blogs, FAQs, and key messages.
Brief spokespeople and staff interviews. Identify and proactively present stories to highlight Roblox’s decisions and efforts around trust, safety and civility.
You have:
A good understanding of consumer technology/social media, online safety, content enforcement, privacy policies
12+ years of experience in public affairs, policy communications and crisis communications
Experience with global regulations and policies for diverse age ranges of users and creators
A track record developing and implementing corporate communications plans aligning internal, external, and partner communications
Proven performance managing communications in crisis and sensitive situations, including creating clear directives and follow up
Strong relationships with key journalists and influencers in tech, policy, and business press
Experience as on the record spokesperson and communicator on complex topics, including policy or legal topics

About the Team
The Dasher & Logistics team is responsible for ensuring every delivery is completed with speed, accuracy and a positive Consumer, Merchant and Dasher experience. Dasher & Logistics owns initiatives that touch all parts of the Dasher life cycle ranging from supply & demand, to cost & quality, to Dasher pay, to Dasher retention, to order batching and beyond. We care about metrics like delivery times, cost per order, delivery quality, dasher compensation, and many more!
About the Role
We are hiring an Associate Manager to help lead strategy and execution for our Dasher & Logistics regulatory markets, the growing set of cities, states, and countries where Dasher pay, benefits, and working conditions are shaped by minimum earnings guarantees, pay transparency requirements, and other logistics specific regulation. You'll own a portfolio of KRs across some of our highest priority business problems by getting into the weeds to understand what's happening on the ground, using data and customer insights to identify opportunities, developing and testing hypotheses, and partnering cross-functionally to bring solutions to life at scale. You will report directly to a Senior Manager on the Dasher & Logistics team.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Own a portfolio of KRs across our regulatory markets, setting the strategy and building the execution plan to hit your goals
Use a data-driven approach to investigate problems, creating insightful analysis from a combination of quantitative and qualitative information, and implement next steps
Operate at the lowest level of detail in order to build strong foundational knowledge of your problem space and provide recommendations for leadership
Define and test hypotheses through experimentation, leverage AI to accelerate learnings, and scale successful strategies across the org
Work cross-functionally across multiple teams to drive alignment and impact, such as Legal, Public Policy, Product, Analytics, Finance, and Marketing
Develop new skills and advance your career, with opportunities to take on new challenges and responsibilities as you progress in your role
We’re excited about you because…
You have 5-7 years of experience in startups, strategy, consulting, financial services, operations, technology, AI, regulatory, or related experience
You are able to analyze and synthesize data, make informed decisions and balance quantitative measurement with an empathetic, intuition-based mindset. You can crunch data in SQL/excel independently and are comfortable owning ambiguous, fast-moving problems with legal and financial stakes
You actively look for ways AI can make your work better, using tools like Claude or Cursor to move faster from data to decision
You focus on getting stuff done and aren’t afraid to get into the details. No job is beneath you and you lead from the front and with optimism
You love thinking about problems from a first principles approach, and you aren't afraid to take action and try new things in order to create the future, while knowing when to bring in the right partners on higher-stakes decisions
You are able to communicate complex topics in a clear and concise way to stakeholders at all levels of the organization and get alignment
You have experience managing cross-functional workstreams or a strong desire to grow into that responsibility
You have a Bachelor's degree in a related field

COMPANY OVERVIEW
KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
TEAM OVERVIEW
The Treasury Operations team supports a wide range of Treasury Operations functions for the insurance business, working collaboratively across Banks, the Investment Team, Third Party Administrators (TPA), Risk Management, and Accounts Payable to manage liquidity and cash activity across multiple legal entities.
POSITION SUMMARY
The successful Analyst must manage responsibilities in a fast-paced environment for multiple legal entities while accommodating enhancements to the existing functions to meet the rapidly changing needs of the business.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Perform daily liquidity management processes supporting operations and investment activity by working collaboratively with Banks, Global Atlantic's Investment Team, Third Party Administrators (TPA), Risk Management, and Accounts Payable
Perform daily review of forecasted items, comparing actual performance to previous forecasts, identify discrepancies and investigate root cause
Support core daily activity including accounting, cash reconciliations, operational reporting, and bank account management
Review and develop analyses, trending reports, and identify deviations from the norm
Contribute to identifying process improvements and participate in company-wide initiatives/projects to improve processes and infrastructure
Explore and apply AI tools to enhance personal productivity and drive innovation in team processes
QUALIFICATIONS
Undergraduate degree required with a minimum of 2 years work experience in a Treasury or Financial Operations role
Knowledge of treasury systems (i.e. treasury workstations, bank web portals) a strong plus
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, strongly required
Prior experience supporting financial controls in compliance with SOX a strong plus
Prior experience in insurance industry a strong plus
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to multi-task and manage multiple responsibilities
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS
Learning agility with strong intellectual curiosity and a drive to continuously grow
Self-starter who takes initiative and proactively addresses issues that may impact the outcome of initiatives
Innovative mindset, open to using and innovating with AI to improve personal productivity and team processes
Ability to identify, communicate, and resolve key issues
Positive attitude even when faced with difficult obstacles, issues or challenges
Commercial mindset with an entrepreneurial spirit
Comfort using AI-powered tools to improve productivity and quality of work
Curiosity about and openness to adopting emerging AI technologies in day-to-day workflows
Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and relevance
